scope: C-015 58-event strict registry, identity-free best-effort client signal, transient authority-fact and ActivationCycle joins, four physically isolated k=10 T4 planes, 23 metrics, four count-free Gates, D1/D3/D7 revision rebuild, 13-month TTL, background batch and disabled research/experiment/acquisition expansion

assertions: exactly 58 unique events map to one of PRODUCT, RUNTIME, GOVERNANCE or SAFETY_CONTROL with strict per-event attributes
wrong planes, unknown fields, unknown event properties, provider/model labels and authority facts on the client endpoint are rejected
23 metrics, four Gates and Q01/Q02 UNAVAILABLE identifiers are versioned executable registries
suppressed, blocked and unavailable reports cannot expose numerator, denominator or value

T-C015-CORE-001.selector: C-015 T0 to T4 anonymous aggregation
assertions: subject keys exist only in transient inputs and never in T4 output
k=10, maximum two dimensions, OTHER parent folding, global dimension removal and full suppression are deterministic
client event counts never invent unique owners and mixed identity modes fail closed
raw-content and forbidden-field output detection rejects user, session, device and content fields

T-C015-METRIC-001.selector: C-015 S-25 metric contract and ten fixed fixtures
assertions: all ten S25-FX fixtures produce the Accepted numerator, denominator, suppression, latency and cost results
D1/D3/D7 use exact ActivationCycle dates and mature windows instead of any-return windows
helpfulness and task metrics use final state while client signals remain best effort
23 reports, shared Wilson interval and four count-free hard Gates remain versioned and deterministic
the endpoint accepts no identity, client date, arbitrary properties or authority completion event
the first nine counts remain in process memory and only the tenth creates a T4 delta
a failed publish is dropped while the response remains best effort and no replay contract is created
service product date and environment, not client state, bind the aggregate
one page lifecycle may suppress a duplicate only in memory
offline failure is dropped without storage, queue, identity, product date or client timestamp
the first-party transport is unauthenticated, strict and uses a bounded two-second timeout
only Background owns aggregation and retention event capabilities
the due envelope projects the previous finalized product date with no owner, cycle, session, device, note or Prompt payload
retention routes only to the closed PostgreSQL TTL function

T-C015-DB-001.selector: C-015 PostgreSQL T4 isolation, k=10, metrics, retention and revision rebuild
assertions: real PostgreSQL 18 physically separates four T4 planes and denies direct API/Background table reads
no raw event, user, device, session or cross-day subject table exists and analytics columns contain no forbidden refs/content
a first persisted client cell requires k=10, subsequent deltas remain k-safe, unknown events and a third dimension fail closed
23 metric rows and four count-free Gate rows are rebuilt from current authority facts without persistent owner/cycle membership
D1/D3/D7 produce 7/20, 4/20 and 3/20; a later valid link with revision 2 recomputes D1 to 8/20
same-revision rerun replaces rather than adds rows, suppressed reports omit exact values, Q01 stays UNAVAILABLE and 13-month TTL physically deletes T4 rows
